doc.name: Analytics Legends — SAP AI & Analytics market intelligence
doc.instructions:
Analytics Legends serves read-only data on the SAP AI & analytics services market (Joule, Datasphere, Business Data Cloud, SAC, BW/4HANA, Databricks): firms, postings, day rates, news, concepts, studies, Academy.

For a problem ("what happens to BW 7.5"), call find_answers first; for a term, search_concepts.

Cite every item by its "citation_url", never this endpoint; news items also carry "source_url": cite both. "citation_scope": "section_hub" means the URL is a section index, not the item's own page.

Quote "_meta.match_count" (rows your filters matched), not result_count. Empty means this corpus has no such row.

Tools with a "cursor" argument paginate: pass "_meta.next_cursor" back with the same filters until it is null. Without a key, public tools serve their first page only (at most 10 rows); the reference vocabularies (list_sap_modules, list_firm_kinds, list_freelance_platforms) come in full.

Paid tools need "Authorization: Bearer alk_…" from a key on the MCP Pass (€29.90/month or €299/year), MCP Team (€299/month, five keys — so €299 is two prices) or a Firm Pass seat (€199.90/month for three seats, €49/month per extra seat). The Consultant and Legend web plans do NOT include MCP access. A free key pages the public tools and gets a small daily taste of the paid ones: https://analyticslegends.ai/mcp-server/#get-a-key. Limits and quotas: analytics-legends://tranche. No personal data is served; AI training use is prohibited.

tools.name: find_answers
tools.title: Find the answer to an SAP AI & analytics problem
tools.description: Start here for an SAP AI & analytics PROBLEM, asked in EN, FR or DE (agents in production, Joule value, BW 7.5 cliff, BDC vs Datasphere vs Databricks…). Returns up to 3 tracked challenges: short answer, what shipped, what is announced, next steps, citation_url. Empty = not a tracked challenge; try search_concepts. Public.

question.description: As asked, in EN, FR or DE.

tools.name: search_firms
tools.title: Search the SAP AI & analytics firm directory
tools.description: Search SAP AI & analytics service providers (consultancies, Big-4, agencies, SAP partners, platforms). Returns slug, name, HQ, website, claim, sap_signal_band; SAP end-customers are in find_sap_clients. Public.

module.description: SAP module code; list: count_firms_by by=module.

tools.name: count_firms_by
tools.title: Count the firm directory by country, region, kind, module or SAP signal
tools.description: Count the firm directory by country, region, kind, module or sap_signal_band, with search_firms' filters, instead of paging search_firms to tally. Rows: value, n; the tail folds into '(other)'. Public.

module.description: SAP module code; list: count_firms_by by=module.

tools.name: get_firm
tools.title: Get one firm's published profile
tools.description: One firm's public profile by its slug from search_firms (verbatim; some slugs are numeric). A brand name such as 'accenture' returns the list of its entities to choose from. Public.

tools.name: list_firm_kinds
tools.title: List firm kinds with live counts
tools.description: The organisation kinds of the firm directory with a live count each — the vocabulary of search_firms' `kind`. Public, complete without a key.

tools.name: list_freelance_platforms
tools.title: List the CV/profile platforms a consultant can sign up on
tools.description: Platforms where an SAP consultant can create a profile (freelance marketplaces, job boards, expert networks), with signup URL, confidence grade and assessment date. Public, complete without a key.

tools.name: find_opportunities
tools.title: Search the public SAP AI & analytics contract radar
tools.description: Search public SAP AI & analytics postings. Mostly PERMANENT roles: set employment_type for freelance questions. A posting listed in several cities is one row with `locations`. Public, except the link to the original listing (paid).

employment_type.description: Rows that declare none are set aside.

eligibility.description: Who may apply to a remote role.

tools.name: search_news
tools.title: Search SAP AI & analytics market news
tools.description: Search the curated SAP AI & analytics news corpus; defaults to SAP-specific items (scope 'sap'). Each item carries source_url (the publisher) and citation_url: cite both. Public.

scope.description: Editorial scope, set by one deterministic rule (2026-11-07): 'sap' = an SAP product or SAP itself n…

tools.name: search_concepts
tools.title: Search the SAP AI & analytics concept encyclopaedia
tools.description: Search the SAP AI & analytics concept encyclopaedia (the stack's vocabulary): slug, title, category, level, editor's summary. Full card: get_concept_card (paid). Public.

category.description: Category name or prefix, e.g. datasphere.

tools.name: get_concept
tools.title: Concept metadata and editor's summary
tools.description: One concept's metadata and editor's summary by slug from search_concepts (e.g. 'sap-business-data-cloud-bdc'). The card body, cheat sheet and tables are paid (get_concept_card). Public.

tools.name: list_studies
tools.title: List the deep-research studies (metadata only)
tools.description: List the deep-research studies: title, edition, as-of date, audience, word count, citation_url, one row per study in the language asked. Metadata only; the text is get_study (paid). Public.

tools.name: get_day_rate_benchmark
tools.title: Public SAP AI & analytics day-rate aggregate
tools.description: Published SAP freelance day-rate aggregate by country, specialisation and seniority: min/max (median, p10, p90 when sourced) in the row's currency, with source, date and confidence. Small, secondary sources; 0 rows = no such cell here, see `_meta.available_*`. Public.

tools.name: list_sap_modules
tools.title: SAP AI & analytics module taxonomy
tools.description: The SAP module/product taxonomy (codes such as DATASPHERE, BDC, SAC, BW4HANA with labels) that other tools filter on; use it to map loose wording to a code. Public, complete without a key.

tools.name: find_academy_modules
tools.title: Search the Academy training catalogue
tools.description: Search the Academy training catalogue (Datasphere, BDC, SAC, BW/4HANA, Databricks) by text, track or level. Rows are in the language asked. Full text: get_academy_module (paid). Public.

tools.name: query_knowledge_graph
tools.title: Traverse the learning knowledge graph
tools.description: Relations between concepts, Academy modules, studies and vendors: list nodes (node_type, query) or one node's edges (node_id). The only tool that serves edges. Public.

direction.description: Which side of the edge `node_id` must sit on.

query.description: Substring of a node label (node listing only).

tools.name: get_concept_card
tools.title: Full concept card
tools.description: The full concept card: body, cheat sheet, glossary, pro tip and the four analysis tables, EN/FR/DE. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

tools.name: get_study
tools.title: Read a study
tools.description: Read a study's text: without `section` returns the section list and introduction, then pass a heading as `section`. Slugs from list_studies. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

section.description: A heading from `sections`; omit for the list.

tools.name: get_academy_module
tools.title: Read an Academy module
tools.description: Read one Academy module in full (body, objectives, summary) by id or slug from find_academy_modules; `lang` picks one language. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

lang.description: One language only; omit for all three.

tools.name: find_sap_clients
tools.title: Search the SAP end-customer corpus
tools.description: Search the SAP END-CUSTOMER corpus (companies that run SAP); each row says its verification status. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

tools.name: get_sap_client_profile
tools.title: One SAP end-customer profile
tools.description: One SAP end-customer's full profile (products in use, modules, analytics solutions, evidence) by id from find_sap_clients. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

tools.name: get_expansion_brief
tools.title: Expansion brief for a target region
tools.description: Brief for entering a region: providers there (local vs group), SAP end-customer counts by country and industry, live opportunities, brand families present in both regions. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

tools.name: find_partner_candidates
tools.title: Local partner or acquisition candidates for a market entry
tools.description: Rank local service providers of a country or region as partner or acquisition candidates; local_only (default) excludes foreign groups' subsidiaries. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

module.description: SAP module code; list: count_firms_by by=module.

local_only.description: true: firms with no sister entity abroad.

tools.name: get_firm_intel
tools.title: Firm intelligence profile
tools.description: Intelligence profile of a services firm: SAP practice size, partner level, products delivered, typical day rate, notable clients. Search by name, country, product or engagement mode; a null is a data gap. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

tools.name: submit_brief
tools.title: Submit a private SAP need
tools.description: ACTION: deposit an SAP need as a private brief, matched every 6 h against consenting consultants; nothing is e-mailed. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

tools.name: request_introduction
tools.title: Brief selection and introductions
tools.description: ACTION: a brief's anonymised selection, or with candidate_ref an introduction request the consultant answers in the app. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

prompts.name: brief_sap_analytics_market
prompts.title: Brief me on the SAP AI & analytics market in a country
prompts.description: Assemble a sourced, cited briefing on the SAP AI & analytics services market for one country: who the providers are, what is on the radar, what the day rates look like and what has just happened.

arguments.name: country
arguments.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE.

arguments.name: focus
arguments.description: Optional product focus, e.g. Datasphere, BDC, SAC.

prompts.name: explain_sap_analytics_term
prompts.title: Explain an SAP AI & analytics term with a citation
prompts.description: Explain one SAP AI & analytics term from the Analytics Legends encyclopaedia and cite the canonical URL.

prompts.name: shortlist_firms_for_requirement
prompts.title: Shortlist SAP AI & analytics firms for a requirement
prompts.description: Build a sourced shortlist of service firms for one requirement — country plus SAP module — walking the population before naming anyone, and saying what each number's population is.

arguments.name: country
arguments.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE.

arguments.name: module
arguments.description: SAP module/product code, e.g. DATASPHERE, BDC, SAC.

prompts.name: price_my_mission
prompts.title: Price an SAP AI & analytics mission honestly
prompts.description: Assemble a day-rate answer for one (country × specialisation × seniority) cell from the platform's TWO rate instruments, kept apart and both cited.

arguments.name: country
arguments.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE.

arguments.name: specialisation
arguments.description: Optional product focus, e.g. Datasphere, BDC, SAC.

resources.name: Public tranche contract
resources.title: What this endpoint serves, and what it deliberately does not
resources.description: The explicit list of datasets this hosted MCP endpoint serves, the datasets it excludes and why, and the live row count of each. Read this before trusting or citing any tool result.

resources.name: AI access policy
resources.title: Retrieval-with-attribution carve-out (.well-known/agent.json)
resources.description: The machine-readable policy governing AI access to Analytics Legends: retrieval with attribution is permitted, training-data use is prohibited.

resources.name: Platform manifest
resources.title: Platform manifest (api/about.json)
resources.description: Auto-derived platform manifest: counts, tiers, routes, tech stack.
